notes: Curated upgrade/modifier records, not a count of purchasable upgrades.
Grouped descriptions are retained if at least one effect modifies a gameplay value; original grouped text is preserved.
Raw extraction coverage is recorded under seedEntries, seedCategories and seedTranslationStringsIncluded.
excludedTranslationRoots describes pre-curation extraction exclusions, not the curation removals.
Standalone UI/status/instructions/costs and unlock-only records were removed through explicit reviewed decisions.
Save-dependent values are not evaluated; angle brackets ⟨value⟩ mark unresolved interpolation parameters.

curation.policy: Explicit value-modifying upgrades and rewards; no standalone labels, status, instructions, costs, or unlock-only text.

entries.name: Bar Charging
entries.text:
Bar Charging

You no longer gain time normally! Instead, fill the Bars to gain time!

⚠ While in the EXALT, your Ambrosia and Purple Bars will not grant Ambrosia or Purple Honey.

Ambrosia Bars and the Purple Bar have fixed lengths, which are divided by your lifetime amount of those values, increased with completions.

Each Ambrosia or Red Ambrosia a Bar would normally grant is converted into time instead, so Luck (and TWO MIND) still matters!

Ambrosia Bar: +0.01 seconds of Global Time per Ambrosia (Average: +⟨secs⟩ seconds) (Requirement is fixed at ⟨req⟩ ABP)

Red Bar: +0.05 seconds of Ascension Time per Red Ambrosia (Average: +⟨secs⟩ seconds) (Requirement is fixed at ⟨req⟩ RABP)

Purple Bar: Each of the Ambrosia and Red Bars has an independent chance to fill, equal to 1 - 2^(-Purple Honey Luck / 100) (Current: ⟨chance⟩%) (Requirement is fixed at ⟨req⟩ PBP)

Purple Ambrosia Synthesis costs -5%

+1 Blueberry. Yes, really.

50 Achievement Points!

1st - +50 Purple Honey Luck. This will be changed, one day.

2nd - Unlock a new Quark Upgrade! Neigh.
